items.text: Jalandhar sits at the centre of two forces most Doaba families weigh directly: it is India's leading sports-goods manufacturing and export hub, with a genuine hand-tools and leather-goods trade alongside it, and it is the sharpest point of Punjab's pull toward studying and settling in Canada, Australia, or the UK.
For many people here, "prepare for IELTS or build a career in India" is not a distant hypothetical - it is the first real fork most young people in this region face.

The question few people examine directly is whether a genuine high-value skill portfolio, built here or applied toward an honestly evaluated abroad plan, could unlock high income opportunities and earlier financial freedom faster than whichever answer feels expected.
